study: Exploratory extension of study 07 from three to five paired seeds
design: Same 28px ResolutionCNN, 45 epochs, Adam 0.001, batch 128; model selection only on existing selection split; thresholds on existing calibration split.
primary: Mean over all five seeds of augmentation-minus-control difference in noise-minus-clean retained error.
reporting: Report every paired seed, five-seed mean, range and paired-seed t interval (df=4). Small-seed interval is exploratory, not patient or clinical uncertainty. Compare additional seeds separately; no seed selection.
external: No new external evaluation: original external models and thresholds remain frozen; raw RSNA images not fetched.
limitations: Known benchmark, same split and architecture; more seeds address initialization/training variation, not external validity. Second architecture remains separate future work.
